fleet_basis.rationale: The Talos installation-media default selects the Kubernetes minor operated by the fleet; the upstream tag resolves that minor to the immutable source commit below.

required_actions: Confirm the Talos fleet preset Kubernetes minor before resolving a replacement tag.
Resolve and record both the annotated tag object and peeled commit with the resolution command.
Update immutable source URLs to the resolved peeled commit.
Regenerate the SourceModel snapshot and bind its new digest into the six-axis receipt before any regenerated output is accepted.
Run the semantic SourceModel delta classification and required wave-gate review before advancing the pin.
pin_change_procedure.prohibited_action: Do not move this pin from a local dev checkout or hand-edit generated port output to absorb an upstream change.
